notes.title: Automate It – Update 1.2.0.0
notes.content:
Performance Improvements
Upgraded the core engine, delivering +20% performance on all machines.
Levels & Achievements Adjustments
Levels are no longer Weekly → they are now Fortnightly.

Achievements for former Weekly levels have been reduced to 15 points.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0.2
notes.content:
Added a new rule that includes solutions using alternative recipes in World 1 as Pro Ranking
 Updated FSR version


Important Note:

The rankings and galleries of World 1 had to be updated due to a discrepancy regarding whether alternative recipes should or should not be considered for the Pro Ranking in that world. Because of this, the rankings for stages W1_L4, W1_L8, W1_L9, and W1_L10 were changed. If you notice any inconsistency after this update (for example, if you previously had both a normal record and a Pro Ranking record), please replay the stages to resave your rankings.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0.1
notes.content:
Added DLSS 4
 Building space is now showed on the building tooltip
 Level builder now checks for buildings outside the building areas to avoid upload of impossible levels

notes.title: Update 1.1.0.0
notes.content:
Added interface dark mode,

Added option to disable auto screenshot when the level is completed,

Now copy and edit key shortcuts will copy/edit the selected building if pressed when a building is selected,

Added option on splitter to disable the rate limit based on the preview,

Now is possible to rotate receivers on level editor,

Stars and best metrics of a solution are now shown in the tooltip,

Fixed pipes disconnecting when copying a solution slot,

Added option to disable weather

notes.title: Patch version 1.0.0.10
notes.content: Weekly Challenges now count up to 10 Stars. Fixed records for everybody that already complete past  Weeklys.

notes.title: ⚙️ What's New & What's Next!
notes.content:
It’s been just over a week since release, and we’re incredibly grateful for the support, feedback, and bug reports you’ve shared. Every message, post, and comment helps us make the game better!

If you’ve played Automate It but haven’t left a review yet, we’d really appreciate it. Your feedback not only helps us improve the game, but also helps more players discover it!
⚙️ Please leave a review

💡 What’s changed so far
Based on your input, we’ve already rolled out several updates to fix bugs, polish the experience, and improve the leaderboard system:

🛠 Fixes and polish

 Resolved issues with shadow quality settings resetting
 Fixed incorrect UI scaling and text sizes, including for some languages
 Autosave description and time star ratings now display correctly
 Placing machines in mid-air is no longer possible
 Liquid and gas objectives now complete properly in No Constraints mode
 Gallery is blurred by default to avoid spoilers
 Tweaked ambient sounds and sound effects

📊 Leaderboards

 Fixed duplicate stars showing up in both Normal and Pro rankings
 Tie-breaks are now handled fairly. Players with identical scores share the same rank

🔧 Gameplay improvements

 Splitters now distribute resources as expected
 Added option to hide future buildings and mechanics in earlier levels
 Addressed a small but pesky 0.05s time discrepancy affecting top-level runs

🏆 Climb the ranks, Make your mark
Every day, the Top-10 Players are posted straight into our Discord. Join the community, compete with the best, and carve your name into Automate It history!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960420/3d5585e3693e37174a304431617538f966de06c4.jpg

🎮 What’s next
Controller support and Steam Deck optimization are in the works. We’re already on it and will keep you posted.

More improvements are on the way, and your feedback continues to shape the future of Automate It!

— Automate It crew

[hr][/hr]

Stay updated through our Forklift Newsletter and swing by Forklift Discord to say hi!

notes.title: Patch version 1.0.0.9
notes.content:
Duplicate Stars in Rankings Fixed:
Fixed an issue where players were receiving duplicate stars in both normal and pro rankings. The system now correctly identifies the best result per player without duplications.
 
 Ranking Ties Handled Properly:
Players with identical performance (time, energy, and space) now share the same rank position. This ensures fairer and more accurate leaderboard placement in the case of ties.

notes.title: Patch version 1.0.0.8
notes.content:
Fixed being possible to place machines mid air,
 Fixed liquid/gas objective not completing on No Constraints mode
 Gallery is now blurry by default to not show solutions
 Fixed World 2 Level 7 time star
 Fixed Autosave description

notes.title: Patch version 1.0.0.7
notes.content:
Fixed incorrect text sizes in some languages,
 Fixed splitter not releasing the full rate of input in certain cases,
 Fixed 0.05s time difference that should not occur, this was noticed in the level 7 of world 1 (lowest time is the correct one so there won't be a best time that could only be achievable on old version),
 Added option to not show any future unlockable buildings and mechanics in previous levels.

notes.title: Switching Tracks: Check This Out!
notes.content:
We’ve Got a Little Gem for You!

Hey, builders! While you're busy perfecting your automation skills in Automate It, we wanted to share a game from our good friend Flazm that’s been stealing our attention lately — Train Valley Origins.

Imagine this: charming locomotives, intricate railway layouts, and brain-teasing challenges that keep you thinking, “Just one more round…”. The demo offers 7 levels for you to try, while the full game will take you through 100 levels, from the Wild West to Japan, and lets you unlock 24 unique trains — from classic steam engines to sleek modern designs. Plus, there will be a built-in level editor, so if you're feeling creative, you'll be able to design your own puzzles!

We’ve had a blast managing switches, optimizing rail networks, and trying not to (ahem) cause too many train collisions. 

Check out the Train Valley Origins Demo

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3522830/Train_Valley_Origins_Demo/

After you’ve played the demo, it would be amazing if you could take a moment to leave a review. Even a few words go a long way in helping indie devs get more visibility on Steam. Plus, they’d love to hear your thoughts and see what you think!

Choo-choo! 🚂

[previewyoutube=DqrRwBHyGtE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Automate It Demo is Here!
notes.content:
🚀 Automate It Demo is Here – Time to Optimize!

The wait is over – the Automate It demo is now available! Test your automation skills and see if you have what it takes to build the most efficient production lines.

What’s in the Demo?

 13 handcrafted levels designed to push your problem-solving and optimization skills to the limit.
 Weekly and Random challenges – it’s not just about making things work, but making them work better. Your solutions will be scored based on space and power usage.
 Global Leaderboard – optimize your solutions and compete with other players.
 Community Hub and Level Editor (demo version) – create your own challenges and share them with the community.
4 Achievements specifically designed for this Demo!
 Multiple ways to solve each challenge – there’s no single correct answer, so experiment and find the best approach!

This is just a taste of what’s to come in the full game, which will feature 50 unique campaign levels, a Level Editor, and weekly challenges to keep your engineering skills sharp.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2636210/Automate_It_Demo/

💡 Enjoying the Demo? We'd love to hear your thoughts! As an indie team, every review helps us gain visibility on Steam, attract more players, and continue improving the game. Please take a moment to leave a review - it really makes a difference in helping us grow and reach a wider audience!

notes.title: Join the January Playtest
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re launching a new closed playtest for Automate It! After making plenty of improvements based on previous feedback, we’re ready to share the latest version with you and hear your thoughts.

This session is smaller and more focused, designed to help us refine the game in preparation for Steam Next Fest. Even if you’ve signed up for playtests on Steam before, you’ll need to fill out a separate application to join this round:

Apply for the Playtest


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960420/16ec4e42368347ac09b293226a31ca1dd1eac65c.jpg

What we’re looking for:


 Passionate players who enjoy Puzzle Automation Games and can dedicate a couple of hours to testing
 If you’re able to record your gameplay, that would be a big plus!
 Honest feedback – especially the critical or negative kind – to help us identify areas for improvement.


We’ll review applications soon and contact selected participants with everything they’ll need to get started.

Your feedback is incredibly valuable, and we can’t wait to hear your impressions of the latest version of Automate It!

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Join the Community Playtest!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re running a special off-schedule playtest for Automate It and are inviting you to join! This session is smaller and more focused, so we can dive deeper into the details and fine-tune the experience.

If you’ve already applied for a playtest on Steam, no worries - your spot in the playtest queue is safe, and you’ll get access to the game later during the larger Steam playtest. For now, though, we’re running this smaller test to gather more detailed feedback from a limited group of players. If you’d like to take part, you’ll need to fill out a separate application here:

Apply for the Playtest

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960420/ce406ca14aaa7f810ae2c494306108774b63de4b.jpg

We’re looking for players who can spend a couple of hours with the game and provide detailed feedback. If you can record your gameplay, that’s even better - it’ll help us see how the game feels for you.

Applications are open until the end of December 8, 2024, and we’ll reach out to the selected participants with all the details.

Thanks for your support! We can’t wait to hear what you think and use your feedback to make Automate It even better!
